ideas.pitch: A graph-based dependency visualizer for local Upstate New York open-source repositories that highlights upstream security vulnerabilities and maintenance drift.
ideas.title: UpstateFLOSS: Open Source Supply Chain Risk Visualizer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages graph intelligence patterns from previous winning projects while addressing local tech ecosystem dependencies in Rochester.

ideas.pitch: A Poisson regression and time-series dashboard for regional farmers markets in Rochester to predict surplus perishable inventory and automate food bank routing.
ideas.title: FingerLakesAgriAI: Local Produce Supply & Demand Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts rigorous statistical forecasting methods that won the Apart Research AI Forecasting Hackathon to a practical local community use case.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered patient onboarding and trust engine tailored for community health clinics in Rochester with instant multilingual intake support.
ideas.title: ClinicBridge Rochester: Patient Acquisition & Multilingual Triage
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the high-impact, rapid patient-acquisition engine approach that secured first prize at the Elevate X hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent RAG system built for university campuses to optimize building energy consumption, schedule waste reduction sweeps, and track carbon offsets.
ideas.title: EcoCampus AI: Multi-Agent University Sustainability Planner
ideas.why_it_could_win: Utilizes the multi-agent student support platform architecture that won first place at the GreenNovation Hackathon.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite monitoring tool to track industrial land changes and environmental compliance along the Erie Canal corridor.
ideas.title: CanalCorridor GeoMonitor: Satellite Land Use Change Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly implements the geospatial monitoring and industrial compliance pattern seen in the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up project.
